acceptance_criteria.when: the user navigates to the Order History page and selects an order
acceptance_criteria.then: the system displays the current status (e.g., Processing, Shipped, Out for Delivery, Delivered) with a timestamp

acceptance_criteria.then: the system updates the status to the latest stage and shows the estimated delivery date
